Name: Quality and Quantity
Author: Ice3ICE3
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#FFD700][b]Quality and Quantity[/b][/color][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][color=#FFAA00][b]Vanilla-Friendly Quality & Quantity Enhancements[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[line]

[color=#66FF99][b][size=5]✦ Overview[/size][/b][/color]

Quality and Quantity is a lightweight, highly compatible SMAPI mod designed to enhance your Stardew Valley experience while staying true to the vanilla gameplay feel.

It introduces smart improvements to buff stacking, item quality control, stack sizes, and precise quantity handling — all without breaking your favorite vanilla workflows.

[line]

[color=#66FF99][b][size=5]✦ Key Features[/size][/b][/color]

[color=#FFCC66][b]• Harmonious Buffs[/b][/color]
Food and drink temporary buffs from different sources can now coexist peacefully. Buffs from the same source will intelligently add duration instead of overwriting.

[color=#FFCC66][b]• Instant Quality Control[/b][/color]
Quickly change the quality of any held item with a configurable keybind (only works on items with positive sell price). Perfect for gifting, selling, or personal use.

[color=#FFCC66][b]• Massive Stack Limits[/b][/color]
Raise the stack limit for all vanilla stackable items from the default 999 up to a generous 99,999 — fully configurable!

[color=#FFCC66][b]• Precise Quantity Prompt[/b][/color]
Hold [b]Shift + Right-Click[/b] on supported vanilla actions to open a clean, precise quantity input window. Works for:
Buying • Crafting • Cooking • Stack Splitting • Stack Transfer

[line]

[color=#66FF99][b][size=5]✦ Requirements[/size][/b][/color]

• [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b]
• [b]SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer[/b]
[b]• Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, highly recommended for easy configuration)[/b]

[line]

[color=#66FF99][b][size=5]✦ Notes[/size][/b][/color]

This mod respects vanilla mechanics as much as possible. Most quantity features either patch or directly call existing vanilla menu systems, only adjusting the relevant values for a seamless experience.

Perfect for players who want more convenience and flexibility without heavy gameplay changes.

[line]

[color=#FFAA00][b]Installation:[/b][/color] Drop the mod folder into your [b]Mods[/b] directory.

[color=#FFAA00][b]Configuration:[/b][/color] Use Generic Mod Config Menu in-game or edit [b]config.json[/b] directly.

[center][color=#888888]Made with love for the Stardew Valley community[/color][/center]
